thread:
devon: Hey @sanjay @irene @maria — PR #17421 is ready for merge but touches the eviction scheduler + runtime kernel selection. Need runtime + infra + security signoffs. Planning to merge during next maintenance window (tomorrow 10:30p PT). Link: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/17421

sanjay: Thanks for the ping. Can you share the short risk summary? Is this a behavioral change or just a config toggle?

devon: It's a tiny behavioral change: fallback ordering now prefers pinned model variants first, then same-region cheaper variants. Code change is ~40 loc. Also flips a default in eviction header: `eviction_threshold = 0.78` -> `0.74`. No schema changes.

irene: That eviction change needs an infra perf sanity check. Could cause earlier evictions under bursty loads. Do we have perf numbers or a quick load run?

devon: Ran a 10m synthetic with seq-dist matching prod (attached logs). Peak p95 tokens latency +8ms, throughput unchanged. Paste of the load command: ```./tools/loadtest --model rdx-xl --qps 450 --seq-dist=prod```

maria: Security question: does this PR change any KMS usage or introduce new env vars? If not, I can do a light review. If it touches fallback logic for model variants, we should ensure no cross-customer cache leakage.

devon: No new env vars or KMS changes. Caching keys unchanged; only routing ordering. I added a unit test that asserts cache isolation.

deploy-bot: CI passed — all checks green (build, unit, integration). Jenkins job #4821.

sanjay: I'll take a look now. Quick ask: can we do a canary to `dedicated-us-west` first for 1 hour? If logs look good, we can promote. If you can schedule the canary in the merge plan that helps approvals.

devon: Yes — plan is: merge -> canary on dedicated-us-west (1h) -> staggered rollout to other regions. Will post canary dashboard link after merge.

irene: I can approve infra once we see a short-run on canary. If you can provide a 30m trace from the load run showing eviction counts, I can give a provisional +1.
devon: Pasted eviction counts snippet from the synthetic run: `evictions_total: 12, evictions_rate_per_min: 0.6` — attached full CSV.

maria: Skimmed the PR. Two minor comments on comments and one test flake I flagged. If those are addressed, I'm fine with security signoff.

sanjay: Left one nit on the rollback script location. Also can we add a brief ops-runbook note that references the new default threshold? Just 1-2 lines.

devon: Will address comments and add runbook note in the PR now. ETA ~20m.

irene: Received the trace, looks ok. Provisional infra +1 pending canary monitoring.

maria: addressed; security +1.

sanjay: acked and +1 for runtime after nit fixed. :thumbsup:

devon: Thanks all — merging after I push the tiny docs change. I'll schedule canary job for tomorrow 10:35p PT and post dashboard link here.

deploy-bot: Merged by devon at 1728503120. Canary job scheduled: jenkins/job/canary-17421/1.

devon: Canary started. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/canary/17421 — monitoring for 60m.

irene: Watching metrics now. Will report back in 15m if any anomalies.

sanjay: Great coordination — thanks. If infra wants escalation during canary ping me.

devon: Appreciate the quick turnaround, team. :)
